description: Modernize the bank routing number pages and their components to the modern fintech look. This is the most outdated area of the site: the bank detail page and RoutingNumberTable still use raw bg-white, rounded-lg, text-3xl/text-xl headings and focus:ring-ink-body. Covers app/(site)/bank-routing-numbers/page.tsx, app/(site)/bank-routing-numbers/[slug]/page.tsx, components/banks/BankSearch.tsx, and components/banks/RoutingNumberTable.tsx. Preserve all JSON-LD (CollectionPage, FinancialService, BreadcrumbList) and all metadata.
steps: bank-routing-numbers/page.tsx (index): Keep the CollectionPage JSON-LD and metadata unchanged. Modernize the breadcrumb (accent hover), keep the centered masthead header (.eyebrow + .page-title), and consider adding a subtle gradient icon badge (LineIcon name 'bank') for a modern accent. Replace the `bg-wash` search section background so it reads consistently with the design system. Update the 'What is a Routing Number?' info section to use .section-title/.section-header typography and .container-prose instead of raw text-2xl/text-lg font-bold headings; keep the oxblood bullet dots OR switch them to accent to match. Wrap major sections in <Reveal>.

components/banks/BankSearch.tsx: Modernize the search input to use the .field-input utility (or match it) with an accent focus state (focus:border-accent focus:ring-1 focus:ring-accent dark:focus:border-accent-light) instead of oxblood ring; keep the search icon and aria-label. Convert the bank result cells from the flat rule-grid into the modern-card pattern: elevated rounded-2xl cards with hover lift + accent border + soft accent glow, a gradient icon badge (LineIcon 'bank'), .title-link bank name, description, routing-number count, and a 'View Details ->' accent CTA. Use `grid gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3` and wrap cards in <Reveal delay={i*0.05}>. Keep the client-side search filtering logic (useState query, filteredBanks) unchanged. Keep the no-results message.

components/banks/RoutingNumberTable.tsx: This is the most outdated component. Replace raw bg-white with bg-surface, rounded-lg/rounded-md with the design-system radius, and focus:ring-ink-body with accent focus (focus:border-accent focus:ring-1 focus:ring-accent). Restyle the search+type-filter controls to match .field-input. Restyle the table to use the .data-table utility (or match its header/row/rule treatment) with tabular-nums routing numbers (keep font-mono for the number column since these are codes), zebra/hover row tint using wash, and accent-consistent styling. Keep ALL filtering logic (query, typeFilter, filteredNumbers, types) unchanged. Keep the result count line.

bank-routing-numbers/[slug]/page.tsx (detail): Keep FinancialService + BreadcrumbList JSON-LD, generateStaticParams, and generateMetadata unchanged. Replace raw heading sizes (text-3xl/text-xl/text-lg font-bold) with .page-title / .section-title / .section-header + serif typography. Modernize the breadcrumb (accent hover). Convert the 'How to Use' info box and the sidebar 'Bank Details' + 'Other Banks' boxes from raw `rounded-lg border bg-white/bg-wash` panels into elevated rounded-2xl cards (border border-hairline bg-surface p-6 dark:border-hairline-dark dark:bg-elevated) consistent with the design system. Switch the bullet dots and 'View All Banks ->' / related-bank links to accent hover styling. Keep the RoutingNumberTable usage and the two-column layout. Wrap sections in <Reveal> where sensible.

Ensure all new hover transforms carry motion-reduce:transform-none, all inputs use accent focus rings, routing numbers stay tabular-nums, and everything is responsive (the routing table must scroll horizontally on mobile via overflow-x-auto).
acceptance_criteria: No raw `bg-white`, `rounded-lg`, `rounded-md`, `focus:ring-ink-body`, or raw `text-3xl/text-2xl/text-xl font-bold` headings remain in the four bank files (headings use .page-title/.section-title/serif tokens; surfaces use bg-surface/bg-elevated).
Bank result cells and the bank-detail info/sidebar panels use the elevated modern-card pattern with accent hover.
Search inputs and the routing-number filter use accent focus rings; routing numbers render in tabular-nums and remain horizontally scrollable on mobile.
CollectionPage, FinancialService, and BreadcrumbList JSON-LD plus all metadata and generateStaticParams are preserved unchanged.
All client-side filtering logic in BankSearch and RoutingNumberTable is unchanged.
`npm run lint` and `npm run build` both pass.
verification: grep for `bg-white`, `focus:ring-ink-body`, and `rounded-lg` in the four bank files and confirm none remain; grep for the three JSON-LD @type values and confirm they are still present.
findings: Modernized all four bank files to the homepage modern-card pattern. BankSearch.tsx: search input now uses accent focus (focus:border-accent focus:ring-1 focus:ring-accent dark:focus:border-accent-light) instead of oxblood ring; result cells converted from the flat rule-grid to elevated rounded-2xl modern cards (group relative flex h-full flex-col overflow-hidden ... hover:-translate-y-1 hover:border-accent/40 motion-reduce:transform-none) with soft accent glow span, gradient icon badge (LineIcon name 'bank'), .title-link bank name, description, routing-number count, and an accent 'View Details ->' CTA with nudging arrow; grid gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 wrapped in Reveal delay={i*0.05}. Client-side filtering (query/filteredBanks) and the no-results message unchanged. RoutingNumberTable.tsx: raw bg-white->bg-surface, rounded-md->design radius, focus:ring-ink-body->accent focus on both the search input and type-filter select; table now uses the .data-table globals utility inside an overflow-x-auto rounded-2xl border+bg-surface wrapper (horizontal scroll on mobile preserved); routing-number column keeps font-mono and now carries tabular-nums; rows use hover:bg-wash tint. All filtering logic (query/typeFilter/filteredNumbers/types) and the result-count line unchanged. index page: breadcrumb hover now accent; added a centered gradient icon badge (LineIcon 'bank') above the .eyebrow+.page-title masthead; wrapped header and info sections in Reveal; 'What is a Routing Number?' now uses .section-header/.section-title + .container-prose and a serif display-4 subheading (no raw text-2xl/text-lg font-bold); bullet dots switched oxblood->accent. detail page: breadcrumb hover accent; h1 now .eyebrow+.page-title; section/box headings now font-serif text-display-4 (no raw text-3xl/text-xl/text-lg font-bold); 'How to Use' box and sidebar 'Bank Details'/'Other Banks' boxes converted from rounded-lg bg-white/bg-wash to rounded-2xl border-hairline bg-surface dark:bg-elevated cards; bullet dots -> accent; website link and related-bank links -> accent hover; 'View All Banks ->' -> accent uppercase CTA; main column wrapped in Reveal. Preserved unchanged: CollectionPage JSON-LD (index), FinancialService + BreadcrumbList JSON-LD (detail), generateStaticParams, generateMetadata, and all metadata. Did not touch data/banks.ts. Note: `.eyebrow-accent`/`.link-accent` globals utilities are still oxblood-based (per FEAT-003 finding), so accent CTAs were written with explicit text-accent dark:text-accent-light classes rather than those utilities. Verified: `npm run lint` -> 'No ESLint warnings or errors'; `npm run build` -> success (all bank routes prerendered, postbuild next-sitemap OK). NOTE ON PUSH: user sent a live steering message asking to push since the repo is public, but as a sub-agent I cannot push/open PRs; committed locally on main and flagged for the orchestrator to push.
